decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication builds on the firm's coolant and fluid-handling know-how for machine-tool users, so it can learn from early results and refine the model line, although it is somewhat less core than the filters.
A hydrocyclone coolant filter sits squarely within the firm's filtration platform and engineering expertise, giving high absorptive capacity to improve it and integrate it into complete systems.
Gravity band filters are a classic, closely related part of the coolant filtration portfolio, so they fit existing knowledge, modular platforms and service, which makes continuation very likely.
